slide-company: Akka builds the platform enterprises use to run agentic systems with the same reliability as the rest of their business.
slide-product: Akka Optimize puts every model call behind one gateway, so you can see, govern and reduce the cost of every AI agent. Let me show you.
spend-cards: This is Cost, in the local console. Across the top: what the AI system cost this week, compared with last week, from every call that went through the gateway.
spend-table: Below it, where the money went. Every use case, prior period against current. I can sort any column, here by the percentage change, filter it, or download it as a spreadsheet.
spend-row: Opening a use case breaks its cost down by model, so I can see which models drove the change.
spend-notes: And like a financial statement, the footnotes say what the figures leave out. Here, that this week is still preliminary.
traces: Now Activity. Every agent run, end to end. Sorting by cost brings the expensive ones to the top, and opening one shows its flow.
trace-open: Each step the agent took, the model it called, and what that call cost.
